'''8fi992b11''' and [[21cu9a]] were the designations of the two files which contained the last pieces of evidence the [[Cularin resistance]] needed to prove the [[Metatheran Cartel]]'s wrongdoings on [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]]. The resistance invaded the [[Metatheran Cartel jungle base]] to retrieve these two files.
